gate_claims.claim: When a regression investigation asks for a reproduction, the triage and root-cause stages also write testbench files and a before-review gate runs simulator.run with expect=fail over the approved RTL under investigation and one testbench at a time, its top taken from that testbench
the reproduction gate is declared by REPRODUCES with each=True, entry=True, expect=fail and before_review
the reproducing() refinement adds the testbench output to a stage when a reproduction is asked for
the triage stage is gated by REPRODUCES and needs a veritriage.investigate session
the triage stage needs a VeriTriage session over the failing artifacts, from veritriage.investigate
veritriage.investigate takes files: no paths, a missing path or a directory is refused
one call makes one session over all the paths it is given, with one classification
every repro must reproduce on its own: one that does not stops the work, even beside one that does
a triage seat's repros each reproduce on their own, one run per repro
with expect=fail a run passes only when the build succeeded, $finish was reached and the one verdict line with this run's nonce reports at least one failed check
the must-fail-each scorer: each repro must pass on the clean inputs and every seeded bug must fail a different repro
the matching of mutants to distinct repro files
one repro that fails every bug cannot stand for two buckets
card: classifying from the first error line only is the triage failure mode
card: triage cites a VeriTriage session and its evidence nodes
